$comment: Pin for oxagen's Stella sidecar transport (oxagen #1072). The smoke test in src/stella-serve.smoke.test.ts boots exactly this stella version's `stella-serve` binary and drives a full multi-step turn through it. Bump stellaVersion deliberately, in its own commit, when upgrading — stella releases daily and this file is the only place oxagen records which release it has verified the wire contract against. NOTE (oxagen #1132): a version MISMATCH no longer skips the test. The smoke test's assertions are themselves the drift detector, so running against an unpinned build is how drift gets caught — and skipping on mismatch is precisely what made stella-sidecar-nightly.yml, which installs `latest` by design, permanently skip-green. Only a missing binary skips.
